result.statement: If $A,B\subseteq \mathbb {Z}^d$ are finite non-empty sets then there exist non-empty $A'\subseteq A$ and $B'\subseteq B$ such that \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] such that $\max (\dim A',\dim B')\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_A;U_B]$.
result.proof: Without loss of generality we can assume that $A$ and $B$ are not both inside (possibly distinct) cosets of the same subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$, or we just replace $\mathbb {Z}^d$ with that subgroup. We prove the result by induction on $\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. Let $\phi :\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ be the natural mod-2 homomorphism. By \Cref{torsion-dist-shrinking} \[ \max (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A)),\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))\leq 10d[U_A;U_B]. \] We now apply \Cref{pfr-projection}, obtaining some subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 40d[U_A;U_B] \] and \[ \mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_B))\leq 34 d[\tilde{\phi }(U_A);\tilde{\phi }(U_B)] \] where $\tilde{\phi }:\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ is $\phi $ composed with the projection onto $\mathbb {F}_2^d/H$. By \Cref{single-fibres} there exist $x,y\in \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ such that, with $A_x=A\cap \tilde{\phi }^{-1}(x)$ and similarly for $B_y$, \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq 34(d[U_A;U_B]-d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]). \] Suppose first that $\lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert =\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. This means that $\tilde{\phi }(A)=\{ x\} $ and $\tilde{\phi }(B)=\{ y\} $, and hence both $A$ and $B$ are in cosets of $\ker \tilde{\phi }$. Since by assumption $A,B$ are not in cosets of a proper subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$ this means $\ker \tilde{\phi }=\mathbb {Z}^d$, and so (examining the definition of $\tilde{\phi }$) we must have $H=\mathbb {F}_2^d$. Then our bound on $\log \lvert H\rvert $ forces $d\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and we are done with $A'=A$ and $B'=B$. Otherwise, \[ \lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert <\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert . \] By induction we can find some $A'\subseteq A_x$ and $B'\subseteq B_y$ such that $\dim A',\dim B'\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and \[ \log \frac{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]. \] Adding these inequalities implies \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] as required.

references.statement: If $G=\mathbb {F}_2^d$ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$ and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables then there is a subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 2 (\mathbb {H}(X)+\mathbb {H}(Y)) \] and if $\psi :G \to G/H$ is the natural projection then \[ \mathbb {H}(\psi (X))+\mathbb {H}(\psi (Y))\leq 34 d[\psi (X);\psi (Y)]. \]

have hcardAx_eq : Nat.card ↑Ax = Nat.card ↑A := by omega
have hcardBy_eq : Nat.card ↑By = Nat.card ↑B := by omega
have hcardAx_n_eq : Set.ncard Ax = Set.ncard A := by
  simpa only [Set.Nat.card_coe_set_eq] using hcardAx_eq
have hcardBy_n_eq : Set.ncard By = Set.ncard B := by
  simpa only [Set.Nat.card_coe_set_eq] using hcardBy_eq
have hA_ncard_le_Ax : Set.ncard A ≤ Set.ncard Ax := by omega
have hB_ncard_le_By : Set.ncard B ≤ Set.ncard By := by omega
have hAx_eq_set : Ax = A := Set.eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le hAx_sub hA_ncard_le_Ax
have hBy_eq_set : By = B := Set.eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le hBy_sub hB_ncard_le_By
have hA_mem : ∀ ⦃a : G⦄, a ∈ A → (QuotientAddGroup.mk' N) a = x := by
  intro a ha
  have ha_in_Ax : a ∈ Ax := by
    rw [hAx_eq_set]
    exact ha
  have ha_fiber : a ∈ {z | z ∈ A ∧ (QuotientAddGroup.mk' N) z = x} := by
    rwa [hAx_eq] at ha_in_Ax
  exact ha_fiber.2
have hB_mem : ∀ ⦃b : G⦄, b ∈ B → (QuotientAddGroup.mk' N) b = y := by
  intro b hb
  have hb_in_By : b ∈ By := by
    rw [hBy_eq_set]
    exact hb
  have hb_fiber : b ∈ {z | z ∈ B ∧ (QuotientAddGroup.mk' N) z = y} := by
    rwa [hBy_eq] at hb_in_By
  exact hb_fiber.2
have h_closure_top_image : AddSubgroup.closure
    (Set.image2 (fun (a b : G) => a - b) A A ∪ Set.image2 (fun (a b : G) => a - b) B B) = ⊤ := by
  simpa [NotInCoset] using h
have hAminusA_sub_N : Set.image2 (fun (a b : G) => a - b) A A ⊆ ↑N := by
  intro z hz
  rw [Set.mem_image2] at hz
  rcases hz with ⟨a, haA, b, hbA, rfl⟩
  have hmap : (QuotientAddGroup.mk' N) (a - b) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hA_mem haA, hA_mem hbA, sub_self]
  have hmemN : a - b ∈ N := by
    rw [← QuotientAddGroup.ker_mk' N]
    exact (AddMonoidHom.mem_ker).2 hmap
  exact hmemN
have hBminusB_sub_N : Set.image2 (fun (a b : G) => a - b) B B ⊆ ↑N := by
  intro z hz
  rw [Set.mem_image2] at hz
  rcases hz with ⟨a, haB, b, hbB, rfl⟩
  have hmap : (QuotientAddGroup.mk' N) (a - b) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hB_mem haB, hB_mem hbB, sub_self]
  have hmemN : a - b ∈ N := by
    rw [← QuotientAddGroup.ker_mk' N]
    exact (AddMonoidHom.mem_ker).2 hmap
  exact hmemN
have hcl_image : AddSubgroup.closure
    (Set.image2 (fun (a b : G) => a - b) A A ∪ Set.image2 (fun (a b : G) => a - b) B B) ≤ N := by
  rw [AddSubgroup.closure_le]
  rw [Set.union_subset_iff]
  exact ⟨hAminusA_sub_N, hBminusB_sub_N⟩
have hNtop : N = ⊤ := by
  have htop_le_N : ⊤ ≤ N := by
    simpa [h_closure_top_image] using hcl_image
  exact le_antisymm le_top htop_le_N
refine ⟨A, B, subset_rfl, subset_rfl, hA, hB, ?_, ?_⟩
haveI hAnonA : Nonempty ↑A := Set.Nonempty.coe_sort hA
haveI hAnonB : Nonempty ↑B := Set.Nonempty.coe_sort hB
have hposA : 0 < (Nat.card ↑A : ℝ) := by
  exact_mod_cast Nat.card_pos
have hposB : 0 < (Nat.card ↑B : ℝ) := by
  exact_mod_cast Nat.card_pos
have hden_ne : (Nat.card ↑A : ℝ) * (Nat.card ↑B : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
  nlinarith [hposA, hposB]
rw [div_self hden_ne, Real.log_one]
have hd_nonneg : 0 ≤ dᵤ[A # B] := ProbabilityTheory.setRuzsaDist_nonneg A B
nlinarith [hd_nonneg]
rw [hNtop] at hrank
norm_num at hrank

lemma weak_PFR_asymm_prelim (A B : Set G) [A_fin : Finite A] [B_fin : Finite B]
    (hnA : A.Nonempty) (hnB : B.Nonempty):
    ∃ (N : AddSubgroup G) (x y : G ⧸ N) (Ax By : Set G), Ax.Nonempty ∧ By.Nonempty ∧
    Set.Finite Ax ∧ Set.Finite By ∧ Ax = {z : G | z ∈ A ∧ QuotientAddGroup.mk' N z = x } ∧
    By = {z : G | z ∈ B ∧ QuotientAddGroup.mk' N z = y } ∧
    (log 2) * Module.finrank ℤ G ≤ log (Nat.card (G ⧸ N)) +
      40 * dᵤ[ A # B ] ∧ log (Nat.card A) + log (Nat.card B) - log (Nat.card Ax) - log (Nat.card By)
      ≤ 34 * (dᵤ[ A # B ] - dᵤ[ Ax # By ])

and points x, y in G/N such that the fibers Ax, By of A, B over x, y respectively are non-empty,
one has the inequality $$\log\frac{|A| |B|}{|A_x| |B_y|} ≤ 34 (d[U_A; U_B] - d[U_{A_x}; U_{B_y}])$$
and one has the dimension bound $$n \log 2 ≤ \log |G/N| + 40 d[U_A; U_B]$$.

theorem PFR_conjecture (h₀A : A.Nonempty) (hA : Nat.card (A + A) ≤ K * Nat.card A) :
     ∃ (H : Submodule (ZMod 2) G) (c : Set G),
      Nat.card c < 2 * K ^ 12 ∧ Nat.card H ≤ Nat.card A ∧ A ⊆ c + H
declarations.doc:
The polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa (PFR) conjecture: if `A` is a subset of an elementary abelian
2-group of doubling constant at most `K`, then `A` can be covered by at most `2 * K ^ 12` cosets of
a subgroup of cardinality at most `|A|`.

  Set.Nonempty.{u_1} A →
    LE.le.{0} (↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑(HAdd.hAdd.{u_1, u_1, u_1} A A))) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} K ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑A)) →
      ∃ H c,
        And (LT.lt.{0} (↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑c)) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} K 12)))
          (And (LE.le.{0} (Nat.card.{u_1} ↥H) (Nat.card.{u_1} ↑A))
            (HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} A (HAdd.hAdd.{u_1, u_1, u_1} c ↑H)))
declarations.conclusion:

  And (LT.lt.{0} (↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑c)) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} K 12)))

result.statement: If $A,B\subseteq \mathbb {Z}^d$ are finite non-empty sets then there exist non-empty $A'\subseteq A$ and $B'\subseteq B$ such that \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] such that $\max (\dim A',\dim B')\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_A;U_B]$.
result.proof: Without loss of generality we can assume that $A$ and $B$ are not both inside (possibly distinct) cosets of the same subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$, or we just replace $\mathbb {Z}^d$ with that subgroup. We prove the result by induction on $\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. Let $\phi :\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ be the natural mod-2 homomorphism. By \Cref{torsion-dist-shrinking} \[ \max (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A)),\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))\leq 10d[U_A;U_B]. \] We now apply \Cref{pfr-projection}, obtaining some subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 40d[U_A;U_B] \] and \[ \mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_B))\leq 34 d[\tilde{\phi }(U_A);\tilde{\phi }(U_B)] \] where $\tilde{\phi }:\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ is $\phi $ composed with the projection onto $\mathbb {F}_2^d/H$. By \Cref{single-fibres} there exist $x,y\in \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ such that, with $A_x=A\cap \tilde{\phi }^{-1}(x)$ and similarly for $B_y$, \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq 34(d[U_A;U_B]-d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]). \] Suppose first that $\lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert =\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. This means that $\tilde{\phi }(A)=\{ x\} $ and $\tilde{\phi }(B)=\{ y\} $, and hence both $A$ and $B$ are in cosets of $\ker \tilde{\phi }$. Since by assumption $A,B$ are not in cosets of a proper subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$ this means $\ker \tilde{\phi }=\mathbb {Z}^d$, and so (examining the definition of $\tilde{\phi }$) we must have $H=\mathbb {F}_2^d$. Then our bound on $\log \lvert H\rvert $ forces $d\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and we are done with $A'=A$ and $B'=B$. Otherwise, \[ \lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert <\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert . \] By induction we can find some $A'\subseteq A_x$ and $B'\subseteq B_y$ such that $\dim A',\dim B'\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and \[ \log \frac{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]. \] Adding these inequalities implies \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] as required.

references.label: torsion-dist-shrinking
references.name: torsion_dist_shrinking
references.statement: If $G$ is a torsion-free group and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables and $\phi :G\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ is a homomorphism then \[ \mathbb {H}(\phi (X))\leq 10d[X;Y]. \]

references.label: pfr-projection
references.name: PFR_projection
references.statement: If $G=\mathbb {F}_2^d$ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$ and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables then there is a subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 2 (\mathbb {H}(X)+\mathbb {H}(Y)) \] and if $\psi :G \to G/H$ is the natural projection then \[ \mathbb {H}(\psi (X))+\mathbb {H}(\psi (Y))\leq 34 d[\psi (X);\psi (Y)]. \]

references.label: single-fibres
references.name: single_fibres
references.statement: Let $\phi :G\to H$ be a homomorphism and $A,B\subseteq G$ be finite subsets. If $x,y\in H$ then let $A_x=A\cap \phi ^{-1}(x)$ and $B_y=B\cap \phi ^{-1}(y)$. There exist $x,y\in H$ such that $A_x,B_y$ are both non-empty and \[ d[\phi (U_A);\phi (U_B)]\log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))(d(U_A,U_B)-d(U_{A_x},U_{B_y})). \]

result.statement: If $A,B\subseteq \mathbb {Z}^d$ are finite non-empty sets then there exist non-empty $A'\subseteq A$ and $B'\subseteq B$ such that \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] such that $\max (\dim A',\dim B')\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_A;U_B]$.
result.proof: Without loss of generality we can assume that $A$ and $B$ are not both inside (possibly distinct) cosets of the same subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$, or we just replace $\mathbb {Z}^d$ with that subgroup. We prove the result by induction on $\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. Let $\phi :\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ be the natural mod-2 homomorphism. By \Cref{torsion-dist-shrinking} \[ \max (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A)),\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))\leq 10d[U_A;U_B]. \] We now apply \Cref{pfr-projection}, obtaining some subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 40d[U_A;U_B] \] and \[ \mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_B))\leq 34 d[\tilde{\phi }(U_A);\tilde{\phi }(U_B)] \] where $\tilde{\phi }:\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ is $\phi $ composed with the projection onto $\mathbb {F}_2^d/H$. By \Cref{single-fibres} there exist $x,y\in \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ such that, with $A_x=A\cap \tilde{\phi }^{-1}(x)$ and similarly for $B_y$, \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq 34(d[U_A;U_B]-d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]). \] Suppose first that $\lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert =\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. This means that $\tilde{\phi }(A)=\{ x\} $ and $\tilde{\phi }(B)=\{ y\} $, and hence both $A$ and $B$ are in cosets of $\ker \tilde{\phi }$. Since by assumption $A,B$ are not in cosets of a proper subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$ this means $\ker \tilde{\phi }=\mathbb {Z}^d$, and so (examining the definition of $\tilde{\phi }$) we must have $H=\mathbb {F}_2^d$. Then our bound on $\log \lvert H\rvert $ forces $d\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and we are done with $A'=A$ and $B'=B$. Otherwise, \[ \lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert <\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert . \] By induction we can find some $A'\subseteq A_x$ and $B'\subseteq B_y$ such that $\dim A',\dim B'\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and \[ \log \frac{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]. \] Adding these inequalities implies \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] as required.

references.name: torsion_dist_shrinking
references.statement: If $G$ is a torsion-free group and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables and $\phi :G\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ is a homomorphism then \[ \mathbb {H}(\phi (X))\leq 10d[X;Y]. \]

references.label: pfr-projection
references.name: PFR_projection
references.statement: If $G=\mathbb {F}_2^d$ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$ and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables then there is a subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 2 (\mathbb {H}(X)+\mathbb {H}(Y)) \] and if $\psi :G \to G/H$ is the natural projection then \[ \mathbb {H}(\psi (X))+\mathbb {H}(\psi (Y))\leq 34 d[\psi (X);\psi (Y)]. \]

references.label: single-fibres
references.name: single_fibres
references.statement: Let $\phi :G\to H$ be a homomorphism and $A,B\subseteq G$ be finite subsets. If $x,y\in H$ then let $A_x=A\cap \phi ^{-1}(x)$ and $B_y=B\cap \phi ^{-1}(y)$. There exist $x,y\in H$ such that $A_x,B_y$ are both non-empty and \[ d[\phi (U_A);\phi (U_B)]\log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))(d(U_A,U_B)-d(U_{A_x},U_{B_y})). \]

result.statement: If $A,B\subseteq \mathbb {Z}^d$ are finite non-empty sets then there exist non-empty $A'\subseteq A$ and $B'\subseteq B$ such that \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] such that $\max (\dim A',\dim B')\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_A;U_B]$.
result.proof: Without loss of generality we can assume that $A$ and $B$ are not both inside (possibly distinct) cosets of the same subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$, or we just replace $\mathbb {Z}^d$ with that subgroup. We prove the result by induction on $\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. Let $\phi :\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ be the natural mod-2 homomorphism. By \Cref{torsion-dist-shrinking} \[ \max (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A)),\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))\leq 10d[U_A;U_B]. \] We now apply \Cref{pfr-projection}, obtaining some subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 40d[U_A;U_B] \] and \[ \mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_B))\leq 34 d[\tilde{\phi }(U_A);\tilde{\phi }(U_B)] \] where $\tilde{\phi }:\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ is $\phi $ composed with the projection onto $\mathbb {F}_2^d/H$. By \Cref{single-fibres} there exist $x,y\in \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ such that, with $A_x=A\cap \tilde{\phi }^{-1}(x)$ and similarly for $B_y$, \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq 34(d[U_A;U_B]-d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]). \] Suppose first that $\lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert =\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. This means that $\tilde{\phi }(A)=\{ x\} $ and $\tilde{\phi }(B)=\{ y\} $, and hence both $A$ and $B$ are in cosets of $\ker \tilde{\phi }$. Since by assumption $A,B$ are not in cosets of a proper subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$ this means $\ker \tilde{\phi }=\mathbb {Z}^d$, and so (examining the definition of $\tilde{\phi }$) we must have $H=\mathbb {F}_2^d$. Then our bound on $\log \lvert H\rvert $ forces $d\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and we are done with $A'=A$ and $B'=B$. Otherwise, \[ \lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert <\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert . \] By induction we can find some $A'\subseteq A_x$ and $B'\subseteq B_y$ such that $\dim A',\dim B'\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and \[ \log \frac{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]. \] Adding these inequalities implies \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] as required.

references.label: torsion-dist-shrinking
references.name: torsion_dist_shrinking
references.statement: If $G$ is a torsion-free group and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables and $\phi :G\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ is a homomorphism then \[ \mathbb {H}(\phi (X))\leq 10d[X;Y]. \]

references.label: pfr-projection
references.name: PFR_projection
references.statement: If $G=\mathbb {F}_2^d$ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$ and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables then there is a subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 2 (\mathbb {H}(X)+\mathbb {H}(Y)) \] and if $\psi :G \to G/H$ is the natural projection then \[ \mathbb {H}(\psi (X))+\mathbb {H}(\psi (Y))\leq 34 d[\psi (X);\psi (Y)]. \]

references.label: single-fibres
references.name: single_fibres
references.statement: Let $\phi :G\to H$ be a homomorphism and $A,B\subseteq G$ be finite subsets. If $x,y\in H$ then let $A_x=A\cap \phi ^{-1}(x)$ and $B_y=B\cap \phi ^{-1}(y)$. There exist $x,y\in H$ such that $A_x,B_y$ are both non-empty and \[ d[\phi (U_A);\phi (U_B)]\log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))(d(U_A,U_B)-d(U_{A_x},U_{B_y})). \]

result.statement: If $A,B\subseteq \mathbb {Z}^d$ are finite non-empty sets then there exist non-empty $A'\subseteq A$ and $B'\subseteq B$ such that \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] such that $\max (\dim A',\dim B')\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_A;U_B]$.
result.proof: Without loss of generality we can assume that $A$ and $B$ are not both inside (possibly distinct) cosets of the same subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$, or we just replace $\mathbb {Z}^d$ with that subgroup. We prove the result by induction on $\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. Let $\phi :\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ be the natural mod-2 homomorphism. By \Cref{torsion-dist-shrinking} \[ \max (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A)),\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))\leq 10d[U_A;U_B]. \] We now apply \Cref{pfr-projection}, obtaining some subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 40d[U_A;U_B] \] and \[ \mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_B))\leq 34 d[\tilde{\phi }(U_A);\tilde{\phi }(U_B)] \] where $\tilde{\phi }:\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ is $\phi $ composed with the projection onto $\mathbb {F}_2^d/H$. By \Cref{single-fibres} there exist $x,y\in \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ such that, with $A_x=A\cap \tilde{\phi }^{-1}(x)$ and similarly for $B_y$, \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq 34(d[U_A;U_B]-d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]). \] Suppose first that $\lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert =\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. This means that $\tilde{\phi }(A)=\{ x\} $ and $\tilde{\phi }(B)=\{ y\} $, and hence both $A$ and $B$ are in cosets of $\ker \tilde{\phi }$. Since by assumption $A,B$ are not in cosets of a proper subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$ this means $\ker \tilde{\phi }=\mathbb {Z}^d$, and so (examining the definition of $\tilde{\phi }$) we must have $H=\mathbb {F}_2^d$. Then our bound on $\log \lvert H\rvert $ forces $d\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and we are done with $A'=A$ and $B'=B$. Otherwise, \[ \lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert <\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert . \] By induction we can find some $A'\subseteq A_x$ and $B'\subseteq B_y$ such that $\dim A',\dim B'\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and \[ \log \frac{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]. \] Adding these inequalities implies \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] as required.

references.statement: If $G$ is a torsion-free group and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables and $\phi :G\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ is a homomorphism then \[ \mathbb {H}(\phi (X))\leq 10d[X;Y]. \]

references.label: pfr-projection
references.name: PFR_projection
references.statement: If $G=\mathbb {F}_2^d$ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$ and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables then there is a subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 2 (\mathbb {H}(X)+\mathbb {H}(Y)) \] and if $\psi :G \to G/H$ is the natural projection then \[ \mathbb {H}(\psi (X))+\mathbb {H}(\psi (Y))\leq 34 d[\psi (X);\psi (Y)]. \]

references.statement: Let $\phi :G\to H$ be a homomorphism and $A,B\subseteq G$ be finite subsets. If $x,y\in H$ then let $A_x=A\cap \phi ^{-1}(x)$ and $B_y=B\cap \phi ^{-1}(y)$. There exist $x,y\in H$ such that $A_x,B_y$ are both non-empty and \[ d[\phi (U_A);\phi (U_B)]\log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))(d(U_A,U_B)-d(U_{A_x},U_{B_y})). \]

    rw [map_sub, hA_mem haA, hA_mem hbA, sub_self]
  have hmemN : a - b ∈ N := by
    rw [← QuotientAddGroup.ker_mk' N]
    exact (AddMonoidHom.mem_ker).2 hmap
  exact hmemN
have hBminusB_sub_N : Set.image2 (fun (a b : G) => a - b) B B ⊆ ↑N := by
  intro z hz
  rw [Set.mem_image2] at hz
  rcases hz with ⟨a, haB, b, hbB, rfl⟩
  have hmap : (QuotientAddGroup.mk' N) (a - b) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hB_mem haB, hB_mem hbB, sub_self]
  have hmemN : a - b ∈ N := by
    rw [← QuotientAddGroup.ker_mk' N]
    exact (AddMonoidHom.mem_ker).2 hmap
  exact hmemN
have hcl_image : AddSubgroup.closure
    (Set.image2 (fun (a b : G) => a - b) A A ∪ Set.image2 (fun (a b : G) => a - b) B B) ≤ N := by
  rw [AddSubgroup.closure_le]
  rw [Set.union_subset_iff]
  exact ⟨hAminusA_sub_N, hBminusB_sub_N⟩
have hNtop : N = ⊤ := by
  have htop_le_N : ⊤ ≤ N := by
    simpa [h_closure_top_image] using hcl_image
  exact le_antisymm le_top htop_le_N
refine ⟨A, B, subset_rfl, subset_rfl, hA, hB, ?_, ?_⟩
haveI hAnonA : Nonempty ↑A := Set.Nonempty.coe_sort hA
haveI hAnonB : Nonempty ↑B := Set.Nonempty.coe_sort hB
have hposA : 0 < (Nat.card ↑A : ℝ) := by
  exact_mod_cast Nat.card_pos
have hposB : 0 < (Nat.card ↑B : ℝ) := by
  exact_mod_cast Nat.card_pos
have hden_ne : (Nat.card ↑A : ℝ) * (Nat.card ↑B : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
  nlinarith [hposA, hposB]
rw [div_self hden_ne, Real.log_one]
have hd_nonneg : 0 ≤ dᵤ[A # B] := ProbabilityTheory.setRuzsaDist_nonneg A B
nlinarith [hd_nonneg]
rw [hNtop] at hrank
norm_num at hrank
have hsub : Subsingleton (G ⧸ ⊤) := QuotientAddGroup.subsingleton_quotient_top
have hnon : Nonempty (G ⧸ ⊤) := ⟨QuotientAddGroup.mk' (⊤ : AddSubgroup G) (0 : G)⟩
have hcard_top : Nat.card (G ⧸ ⊤) = 1 := (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique).2 ⟨hsub, hnon⟩
rw [hcard_top, Nat.cast_one, Real.log_one] at hrank
have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
have hrank_clean : Real.log 2 * ↑(Module.finrank ℤ G) ≤ (40:ℝ) * dᵤ[A # B] := by
  nlinarith [hrank]
have hfinA : AffineSpace.finrank ℤ A ≤ Module.finrank ℤ G := ProofSteps.finrank_le A
have hfinB : AffineSpace.finrank ℤ B ≤ Module.finrank ℤ G := ProofSteps.finrank_le B
have hdim_le : AffineSpace.finrank ℤ A ⊔ AffineSpace.finrank ℤ B ≤
    Module.finrank ℤ G := sup_le hfinA hfinB
have hcoef : ((40:ℝ) * dᵤ[A # B]) / Real.log 2 = (40:ℝ) / Real.log 2 * dᵤ[A # B] := by
  ring
rw [← hcoef]
rw [le_div_iff₀ hlog2_pos]
calc
  ↑(AffineSpace.finrank ℤ A ⊔ AffineSpace.finrank ℤ B) * Real.log 2
      ≤ ↑(Module.finrank ℤ G) * Real.log 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hdim_le) (le_of_lt hlog2_pos)
  _ = Real.log 2 * ↑(Module.finrank ℤ G) := mul_comm _ _
  _ ≤ (40:ℝ) * dᵤ[A # B] := hrank_clean

result.statement: If $A,B\subseteq \mathbb {Z}^d$ are finite non-empty sets then there exist non-empty $A'\subseteq A$ and $B'\subseteq B$ such that \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] such that $\max (\dim A',\dim B')\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_A;U_B]$.
result.proof: Without loss of generality we can assume that $A$ and $B$ are not both inside (possibly distinct) cosets of the same subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$, or we just replace $\mathbb {Z}^d$ with that subgroup. We prove the result by induction on $\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. Let $\phi :\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ be the natural mod-2 homomorphism. By \Cref{torsion-dist-shrinking} \[ \max (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A)),\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))\leq 10d[U_A;U_B]. \] We now apply \Cref{pfr-projection}, obtaining some subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 40d[U_A;U_B] \] and \[ \mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_B))\leq 34 d[\tilde{\phi }(U_A);\tilde{\phi }(U_B)] \] where $\tilde{\phi }:\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ is $\phi $ composed with the projection onto $\mathbb {F}_2^d/H$. By \Cref{single-fibres} there exist $x,y\in \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ such that, with $A_x=A\cap \tilde{\phi }^{-1}(x)$ and similarly for $B_y$, \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq 34(d[U_A;U_B]-d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]). \] Suppose first that $\lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert =\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. This means that $\tilde{\phi }(A)=\{ x\} $ and $\tilde{\phi }(B)=\{ y\} $, and hence both $A$ and $B$ are in cosets of $\ker \tilde{\phi }$. Since by assumption $A,B$ are not in cosets of a proper subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$ this means $\ker \tilde{\phi }=\mathbb {Z}^d$, and so (examining the definition of $\tilde{\phi }$) we must have $H=\mathbb {F}_2^d$. Then our bound on $\log \lvert H\rvert $ forces $d\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and we are done with $A'=A$ and $B'=B$. Otherwise, \[ \lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert <\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert . \] By induction we can find some $A'\subseteq A_x$ and $B'\subseteq B_y$ such that $\dim A',\dim B'\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and \[ \log \frac{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]. \] Adding these inequalities implies \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] as required.

references.statement: If $G$ is a torsion-free group and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables and $\phi :G\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ is a homomorphism then \[ \mathbb {H}(\phi (X))\leq 10d[X;Y]. \]

references.label: pfr-projection
references.name: PFR_projection
references.statement: If $G=\mathbb {F}_2^d$ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$ and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables then there is a subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 2 (\mathbb {H}(X)+\mathbb {H}(Y)) \] and if $\psi :G \to G/H$ is the natural projection then \[ \mathbb {H}(\psi (X))+\mathbb {H}(\psi (Y))\leq 34 d[\psi (X);\psi (Y)]. \]

references.label: single-fibres
references.name: single_fibres
references.statement: Let $\phi :G\to H$ be a homomorphism and $A,B\subseteq G$ be finite subsets. If $x,y\in H$ then let $A_x=A\cap \phi ^{-1}(x)$ and $B_y=B\cap \phi ^{-1}(y)$. There exist $x,y\in H$ such that $A_x,B_y$ are both non-empty and \[ d[\phi (U_A);\phi (U_B)]\log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))(d(U_A,U_B)-d(U_{A_x},U_{B_y})). \]

def WeakPFRAsymmConclusion (A B : Set G) : Prop :=
  ∃ A' B' : Set G, A' ⊆ A ∧ B' ⊆ B ∧ A'.Nonempty ∧ B'.Nonempty ∧
  log ((Nat.card A * Nat.card B) / (Nat.card A' * (Nat.card B'))) ≤ 34 * dᵤ[A # B] ∧
  max (AffineSpace.finrank ℤ A') (AffineSpace.finrank ℤ B') ≤ (40 / log 2) * dᵤ[A # B]

declarations.name: Lean.MVarId.wlog
declarations.source_snippet:
def _root_.Lean.MVarId.wlog (goal : MVarId) (h : Option Name) (P : Expr)
    (xs : Option (TSyntaxArray `ident) := none) (H : Option Name := none) :
    TacticM WLOGResult := goal.withContext do
  goal.checkNotAssigned `wlog
  let H := H.getD `this
  let inaccessible := h.isNone
  let h := h.getD `h
                                                                                                   
                   
  let HSuffix := Expr.forallE h P (← goal.getType) .default
  let fvars ← getFVarIdsAt goal xs
  let fvars := fvars.map Expr.fvar
  let lctx := (← goal.getDecl).lctx
  let (revertedFVars, HType) ← liftMkBindingM fun ctx => (do
    let f ← collectForwardDeps lctx fvars
    let revertedFVars := filterOutImplementationDetails lctx (f.map Expr.fvarId!)
    let HType ← withFreshCache do mkAuxMVarType lctx (revertedFVars.map Expr.fvar) .natural HSuffix
    return (revertedFVars, HType))
      { preserveOrder := false, mainModule := ctx.mainModule }
                                                                                                   
                                  
  let HExpr ← mkFreshExprSyntheticOpaqueMVar HType
  let hGoal := HExpr.mvarId!
                                                                                            
                                                         
  let (HFVarId, reductionGoal) ←
    goal.assertHypotheses #[{ userName := H, type := HType, value := HExpr }]
  let HFVarId := HFVarId[0]!
                                                                                       
  let hGoal ← hGoal.tryClearMany revertedFVars
                                                                                                  
                                                  
  let (_, hGoal) ← hGoal.introNP revertedFVars.size
                                         
  let (hFVar, hGoal) ← if inaccessible then hGoal.intro1 else hGoal.intro1P
                                                                                            
                                                                                                 
  let (⟨easyGoal, hyp⟩, ⟨reductionGoal, negHyp⟩) ←
    reductionGoal.byCases P <| if inaccessible then `_ else h
  easyGoal.withContext do
                                                 
    let HArgFVarIds ← revertedFVars.filterM (notM ·.isLetVar)
    let HApp ← instantiateMVars <|
      mkAppN (.fvar HFVarId) (HArgFVarIds.map .fvar) |>.app (.fvar hyp)
    ensureHasNoMVars HApp
    easyGoal.assign HApp
  return ⟨reductionGoal, (HFVarId, negHyp), hGoal, hFVar, revertedFVars⟩

                                                                                                   
                                                                                                   

                                                                                              
            
                                                  
                                                                                        
                                                                                               
                      

                                                                         
                                                                    
                                                                                    
                                                     

                                              
syntax (name := wlog) "wlog " binderIdent " : " term
  (" generalizing" (ppSpace colGt ident)*)? (" with " binderIdent)? : tactic

elab_rules : tactic
| `(tactic| wlog $h:binderIdent : $P:term $[ generalizing $xs*]? $[ with $H:ident]?) =>
  withMainContext do
  let H := H.map (·.getId)
  let h := match h with
  | `(binderIdent|$h:ident) => some h.getId
  | _ => none
  let P ← elabType P
  let goal ← getMainGoal
  let { reductionGoal, hypothesisGoal .. } ← goal.wlog h P xs H
  replaceMainGoal [reductionGoal, hypothesisGoal]
declarations.doc:
`wlog goal h P xs H` will return two goals: the `hypothesisGoal`, which adds an assumption
`h : P` to the context of `goal`, and the `reductionGoal`, which requires showing that the case
`h : ¬ P` can be reduced to the case where `P` holds (typically by symmetry).

In `reductionGoal`, there will be two additional assumptions:
- `h : ¬ P`: the assumption that `P` does not hold
- `H`: which is the statement that in the old context `P` suffices to prove the goal.
  If `H` is `none`, the name `this` is used.

If `xs` is `none`, all hypotheses are reverted to produce the reduction goal's hypothesis `H`.
Otherwise, the `xs` are elaborated to hypotheses in the context of `goal`, and only those
hypotheses are reverted (and any that depend on them).

If `h` is `none`, the hypotheses of types `P` and `¬ P` in both branches will be inaccessible.

def WeakPFRAsymmConclusion (A B : Set G) : Prop :=
  ∃ A' B' : Set G, A' ⊆ A ∧ B' ⊆ B ∧ A'.Nonempty ∧ B'.Nonempty ∧
  log ((Nat.card A * Nat.card B) / (Nat.card A' * (Nat.card B'))) ≤ 34 * dᵤ[A # B] ∧
  max (AffineSpace.finrank ℤ A') (AffineSpace.finrank ℤ B') ≤ (40 / log 2) * dᵤ[A # B]

its intersection with `s` and its image in the quotient `α ⧸ s` is strictly monotone, even though
it is not injective in general.

declarations.name: MeasureTheory.FiniteMeasure.injective_toWeakDualBCNN
declarations.source_snippet:
lemma injective_toWeakDualBCNN :
    Injective (toWeakDualBCNN : FiniteMeasure Ω → WeakDual ℝ≥0 (Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0))
declarations.doc:
The mapping `toWeakDualBCNN` from finite Borel measures to the weak dual of `Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0` is
injective, if in the underlying space `Ω`, indicator functions of closed sets have decreasing
approximations by sequences of continuous functions (in particular if `Ω` is pseudometrizable).

declarations.name: WeakDual.isClosed_image_polar_of_mem_nhds
declarations.source_snippet:
theorem isClosed_image_polar_of_mem_nhds {s : Set E} (s_nhd : s ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E)) :
    IsClosed (((↑) : WeakDual 𝕜 E → E → 𝕜) '' polar 𝕜 s)
declarations.doc:
The image under `↑ : WeakDual 𝕜 E → (E → 𝕜)` of a polar `WeakDual.polar 𝕜 s` of a
neighborhood `s` of the origin is a closed set.

declarations.name: Submonoid.equivMapOfInjective

result.statement: If $A,B\subseteq \mathbb {Z}^d$ are finite non-empty sets then there exist non-empty $A'\subseteq A$ and $B'\subseteq B$ such that \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] such that $\max (\dim A',\dim B')\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_A;U_B]$.
result.proof: Without loss of generality we can assume that $A$ and $B$ are not both inside (possibly distinct) cosets of the same subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$, or we just replace $\mathbb {Z}^d$ with that subgroup. We prove the result by induction on $\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. Let $\phi :\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ be the natural mod-2 homomorphism. By \Cref{torsion-dist-shrinking} \[ \max (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A)),\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))\leq 10d[U_A;U_B]. \] We now apply \Cref{pfr-projection}, obtaining some subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 40d[U_A;U_B] \] and \[ \mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_B))\leq 34 d[\tilde{\phi }(U_A);\tilde{\phi }(U_B)] \] where $\tilde{\phi }:\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ is $\phi $ composed with the projection onto $\mathbb {F}_2^d/H$. By \Cref{single-fibres} there exist $x,y\in \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ such that, with $A_x=A\cap \tilde{\phi }^{-1}(x)$ and similarly for $B_y$, \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq 34(d[U_A;U_B]-d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]). \] Suppose first that $\lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert =\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. This means that $\tilde{\phi }(A)=\{ x\} $ and $\tilde{\phi }(B)=\{ y\} $, and hence both $A$ and $B$ are in cosets of $\ker \tilde{\phi }$. Since by assumption $A,B$ are not in cosets of a proper subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$ this means $\ker \tilde{\phi }=\mathbb {Z}^d$, and so (examining the definition of $\tilde{\phi }$) we must have $H=\mathbb {F}_2^d$. Then our bound on $\log \lvert H\rvert $ forces $d\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and we are done with $A'=A$ and $B'=B$. Otherwise, \[ \lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert <\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert . \] By induction we can find some $A'\subseteq A_x$ and $B'\subseteq B_y$ such that $\dim A',\dim B'\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and \[ \log \frac{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]. \] Adding these inequalities implies \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] as required.

references.name: torsion_dist_shrinking
references.statement: If $G$ is a torsion-free group and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables and $\phi :G\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ is a homomorphism then \[ \mathbb {H}(\phi (X))\leq 10d[X;Y]. \]

references.label: pfr-projection
references.name: PFR_projection
references.statement: If $G=\mathbb {F}_2^d$ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$ and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables then there is a subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 2 (\mathbb {H}(X)+\mathbb {H}(Y)) \] and if $\psi :G \to G/H$ is the natural projection then \[ \mathbb {H}(\psi (X))+\mathbb {H}(\psi (Y))\leq 34 d[\psi (X);\psi (Y)]. \]

references.label: single-fibres
references.name: single_fibres
references.statement: Let $\phi :G\to H$ be a homomorphism and $A,B\subseteq G$ be finite subsets. If $x,y\in H$ then let $A_x=A\cap \phi ^{-1}(x)$ and $B_y=B\cap \phi ^{-1}(y)$. There exist $x,y\in H$ such that $A_x,B_y$ are both non-empty and \[ d[\phi (U_A);\phi (U_B)]\log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))(d(U_A,U_B)-d(U_{A_x},U_{B_y})). \]

declarations.name: WeakPFRAsymmConclusion
declarations.source_snippet:
def WeakPFRAsymmConclusion (A B : Set G) : Prop :=
  ∃ A' B' : Set G, A' ⊆ A ∧ B' ⊆ B ∧ A'.Nonempty ∧ B'.Nonempty ∧
  log ((Nat.card A * Nat.card B) / (Nat.card A' * (Nat.card B'))) ≤ 34 * dᵤ[A # B] ∧
  max (AffineSpace.finrank ℤ A') (AffineSpace.finrank ℤ B') ≤ (40 / log 2) * dᵤ[A # B]

/-- The property of two sets A,B of a group G not being contained in cosets of the same proper subgroup -/
declarations.doc: Separating out the conclusion of `weak_PFR_asymm` for convenience of induction arguments.

        (And (Set.Nonempty.{u_1} A')

declarations.name: MonoidHom.transfer
declarations.source_snippet:
@[to_additive "Given `ϕ : H →+ A` from `H : AddSubgroup G` to an additive commutative group `A`,
the transfer homomorphism is `transfer ϕ : G →+ A`."]
noncomputable def transfer [FiniteIndex H] : G →* A :=
  let T : leftTransversals (H : Set G) := Inhabited.default
  { toFun := fun g => diff ϕ T (g • T)
                                                                                                                     
    map_one' := by beta_reduce; rw [one_smul, diff_self]
                                                                
    map_mul' := fun g h => by simp only; rw [mul_smul, ← diff_mul_diff, smul_diff_smul] }

variable (T : leftTransversals (H : Set G))
declarations.doc:
Given `ϕ : H →* A` from `H : Subgroup G` to a commutative group `A`,
the transfer homomorphism is `transfer ϕ : G →* A`.

declarations.name: MonoidHom.transferSylow
declarations.source_snippet:
noncomputable def transferSylow [FiniteIndex (P : Subgroup G)] : G →* (P : Subgroup G) :=
  @transfer G _ P P
    (@Subgroup.IsCommutative.commGroup G _ P
      ⟨⟨fun a b => Subtype.ext (hP (le_normalizer b.2) a a.2)⟩⟩)
    (MonoidHom.id P) _

variable [Fact p.Prime] [Finite (Sylow p G)]
declarations.doc: The homomorphism `G →* P` in Burnside's transfer theorem.

declarations.name: WeakPFRAsymmConclusion
declarations.source_snippet:
def WeakPFRAsymmConclusion (A B : Set G) : Prop :=
  ∃ A' B' : Set G, A' ⊆ A ∧ B' ⊆ B ∧ A'.Nonempty ∧ B'.Nonempty ∧
  log ((Nat.card A * Nat.card B) / (Nat.card A' * (Nat.card B'))) ≤ 34 * dᵤ[A # B] ∧
  max (AffineSpace.finrank ℤ A') (AffineSpace.finrank ℤ B') ≤ (40 / log 2) * dᵤ[A # B]

/-- The property of two sets A,B of a group G not being contained in cosets of the same proper subgroup -/

declarations.name: weak_PFR_asymm_prelim
declarations.source_snippet:
lemma weak_PFR_asymm_prelim (A B : Set G) [A_fin : Finite A] [B_fin : Finite B]
    (hnA : A.Nonempty) (hnB : B.Nonempty):
    ∃ (N : AddSubgroup G) (x y : G ⧸ N) (Ax By : Set G), Ax.Nonempty ∧ By.Nonempty ∧
    Set.Finite Ax ∧ Set.Finite By ∧ Ax = {z : G | z ∈ A ∧ QuotientAddGroup.mk' N z = x } ∧
    By = {z : G | z ∈ B ∧ QuotientAddGroup.mk' N z = y } ∧
    (log 2) * Module.finrank ℤ G ≤ log (Nat.card (G ⧸ N)) +
      40 * dᵤ[ A # B ] ∧ log (Nat.card A) + log (Nat.card B) - log (Nat.card Ax) - log (Nat.card By)
      ≤ 34 * (dᵤ[ A # B ] - dᵤ[ Ax # By ])
declarations.doc:
Given two non-empty finite subsets A, B of a rank n free Z-module G, there exists a subgroup N
and points x, y in G/N such that the fibers Ax, By of A, B over x, y respectively are non-empty,
one has the inequality $$\log\frac{|A| |B|}{|A_x| |B_y|} ≤ 34 (d[U_A; U_B] - d[U_{A_x}; U_{B_y}])$$
and one has the dimension bound $$n \log 2 ≤ \log |G/N| + 40 d[U_A; U_B]$$.

  [inst_5 : MeasurableSingletonClass.{u_1} G] (A B : Set.{u_1} G) [A_fin : Finite.{u_1 + 1} ↑A]
  [B_fin : Finite.{u_1 + 1} ↑B],

              (And (Set.Finite.{u_1} By)
                (And
                  (Eq.{u_1 + 1} Ax
                    (setOf.{u_1} fun z =>
                      And (Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} A z) (Eq.{u_1 + 1} ((QuotientAddGroup.mk'.{u_1} N) z) x)))
                  (And
                    (Eq.{u_1 + 1} By
                      (setOf.{u_1} fun z =>
                        And (Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} B z) (Eq.{u_1 + 1} ((QuotientAddGroup.mk'.{u_1} N) z) y)))

                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u_1, u_1} G N)))
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 40 dᵤ[A # B])))
                      (LE.le.{0}
                        (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0}
                          (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0}
                            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑A)) (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑B)))

declarations.name: SuccOrder.ofOrderIso
declarations.source_snippet:
protected abbrev SuccOrder.ofOrderIso [SuccOrder X] (f : X ≃o Y) : SuccOrder Y where
  succ y := f (succ (f.symm y))
  le_succ y := by rw [← map_inv_le_iff f]; exact le_succ (f.symm y)
  max_of_succ_le h := by
    rw [← f.symm.isMax_apply]
    refine max_of_succ_le ?_
    simp [f.le_symm_apply, h]
  succ_le_of_lt h := by rw [← le_map_inv_iff]; exact succ_le_of_lt (by simp [h])
declarations.doc: `SuccOrder` transfers across equivalences between orders.

declarations.name: PredOrder.ofOrderIso
declarations.source_snippet:
protected abbrev PredOrder.ofOrderIso [PredOrder X] (f : X ≃o Y) :
    PredOrder Y where
  pred y := f (pred (f.symm y))
  pred_le y := by rw [← le_map_inv_iff f]; exact pred_le (f.symm y)
  min_of_le_pred h := by
    rw [← f.symm.isMin_apply]
    refine min_of_le_pred ?_
    simp [f.symm_apply_le, h]
  le_pred_of_lt h := by rw [← map_inv_le_iff]; exact le_pred_of_lt (by simp [h])
declarations.doc: `PredOrder` transfers across equivalences between orders.

result.statement: If $A,B\subseteq \mathbb {Z}^d$ are finite non-empty sets then there exist non-empty $A'\subseteq A$ and $B'\subseteq B$ such that \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] such that $\max (\dim A',\dim B')\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_A;U_B]$.
result.proof: Without loss of generality we can assume that $A$ and $B$ are not both inside (possibly distinct) cosets of the same subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$, or we just replace $\mathbb {Z}^d$ with that subgroup. We prove the result by induction on $\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. Let $\phi :\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ be the natural mod-2 homomorphism. By \Cref{torsion-dist-shrinking} \[ \max (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A)),\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))\leq 10d[U_A;U_B]. \] We now apply \Cref{pfr-projection}, obtaining some subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 40d[U_A;U_B] \] and \[ \mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_B))\leq 34 d[\tilde{\phi }(U_A);\tilde{\phi }(U_B)] \] where $\tilde{\phi }:\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ is $\phi $ composed with the projection onto $\mathbb {F}_2^d/H$. By \Cref{single-fibres} there exist $x,y\in \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ such that, with $A_x=A\cap \tilde{\phi }^{-1}(x)$ and similarly for $B_y$, \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq 34(d[U_A;U_B]-d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]). \] Suppose first that $\lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert =\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. This means that $\tilde{\phi }(A)=\{ x\} $ and $\tilde{\phi }(B)=\{ y\} $, and hence both $A$ and $B$ are in cosets of $\ker \tilde{\phi }$. Since by assumption $A,B$ are not in cosets of a proper subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$ this means $\ker \tilde{\phi }=\mathbb {Z}^d$, and so (examining the definition of $\tilde{\phi }$) we must have $H=\mathbb {F}_2^d$. Then our bound on $\log \lvert H\rvert $ forces $d\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and we are done with $A'=A$ and $B'=B$. Otherwise, \[ \lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert <\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert . \] By induction we can find some $A'\subseteq A_x$ and $B'\subseteq B_y$ such that $\dim A',\dim B'\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and \[ \log \frac{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]. \] Adding these inequalities implies \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] as required.

references.statement: If $G=\mathbb {F}_2^d$ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$ and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables then there is a subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 2 (\mathbb {H}(X)+\mathbb {H}(Y)) \] and if $\psi :G \to G/H$ is the natural projection then \[ \mathbb {H}(\psi (X))+\mathbb {H}(\psi (Y))\leq 34 d[\psi (X);\psi (Y)]. \]

references.statement: Let $\phi :G\to H$ be a homomorphism and $A,B\subseteq G$ be finite subsets. If $x,y\in H$ then let $A_x=A\cap \phi ^{-1}(x)$ and $B_y=B\cap \phi ^{-1}(y)$. There exist $x,y\in H$ such that $A_x,B_y$ are both non-empty and \[ d[\phi (U_A);\phi (U_B)]\log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))(d(U_A,U_B)-d(U_{A_x},U_{B_y})). \]

declarations.source_snippet:
lemma weak_PFR_asymm_prelim (A B : Set G) [A_fin : Finite A] [B_fin : Finite B]
    (hnA : A.Nonempty) (hnB : B.Nonempty):
    ∃ (N : AddSubgroup G) (x y : G ⧸ N) (Ax By : Set G), Ax.Nonempty ∧ By.Nonempty ∧
    Set.Finite Ax ∧ Set.Finite By ∧ Ax = {z : G | z ∈ A ∧ QuotientAddGroup.mk' N z = x } ∧
    By = {z : G | z ∈ B ∧ QuotientAddGroup.mk' N z = y } ∧
    (log 2) * Module.finrank ℤ G ≤ log (Nat.card (G ⧸ N)) +
      40 * dᵤ[ A # B ] ∧ log (Nat.card A) + log (Nat.card B) - log (Nat.card Ax) - log (Nat.card By)
      ≤ 34 * (dᵤ[ A # B ] - dᵤ[ Ax # By ])
declarations.doc:
Given two non-empty finite subsets A, B of a rank n free Z-module G, there exists a subgroup N
and points x, y in G/N such that the fibers Ax, By of A, B over x, y respectively are non-empty,
one has the inequality $$\log\frac{|A| |B|}{|A_x| |B_y|} ≤ 34 (d[U_A; U_B] - d[U_{A_x}; U_{B_y}])$$
and one has the dimension bound $$n \log 2 ≤ \log |G/N| + 40 d[U_A; U_B]$$.

                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u_1, u_1} G N)))
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 40 dᵤ[A # B])))

declarations.name: modNBasis
declarations.source_snippet:
noncomputable def modNBasis : Basis (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ G) (ZMod n) (modN G n) := by
  set ψ : G →+ G := zsmulAddGroupHom n
  set nG := LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ G n)
  set H := G ⧸ nG
  set φ : G →ₗ[ℤ] H := nG.mkQ
  let B := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ G
  let bG : Basis B ℤ G := Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ G
  let mod : (B →₀ ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] (B →₀ ZMod n) := mapRange.linearMap (Int.castAddHom _).toIntLinearMap
  let f : G →ₗ[ℤ] (B →₀ ℤ) := bG.repr
  have hker : nG ≤ LinearMap.ker (mod.comp f) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    ext b
    simp [mod, f, nG, CharP.ofNat_eq_zero]
  let g : H →ₗ[ℤ] (B →₀ ZMod n) := nG.liftQ (mod.comp f) hker
  refine ⟨.ofBijective (g.toAddMonoidHom.toZModLinearMap n) ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [AddMonoidHom.coe_toZModLinearMap, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, injective_iff_map_eq_zero,
      nG.mkQ_surjective.forall]
    intro x hx
    simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, g] at hx
    rw [Submodule.liftQ_apply] at hx
    simp [mod, DFunLike.ext_iff, ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hx
    simp
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    choose c hc using hx
    refine ⟨bG.repr.symm ⟨(f x).support, c, by simp [hc, NeZero.ne]⟩, bG.repr.injective ?_⟩
    simpa [DFunLike.ext_iff, eq_comm] using hc
  · suffices mod ∘ bG.repr = g ∘ nG.mkQ by
      exact (this ▸ (mapRange_surjective _ (map_zero _) ZMod.intCast_surjective).comp
        bG.repr.surjective).of_comp
    ext x b
    simp [mod, comp_apply, mapRange.addMonoidHom_apply, Int.coe_castAddHom,
      mapRange_apply, QuotientAddGroup.coe_mk', g, f]
    rfl

  let mod : (B →₀ ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] (B →₀ ZMod n) := mapRange.linearMap (Int.castAddHom _).toIntLinearMap
  let f : G →ₗ[ℤ] (B →₀ ℤ) := bG.repr
  have hker : nG ≤ LinearMap.ker (mod.comp f) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    ext b
    simp [mod, f, nG, CharP.ofNat_eq_zero]
  let g : H →ₗ[ℤ] (B →₀ ZMod n) := nG.liftQ (mod.comp f) hker
  refine ⟨.ofBijective (g.toAddMonoidHom.toZModLinearMap n) ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [AddMonoidHom.coe_toZModLinearMap, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, injective_iff_map_eq_zero,
      nG.mkQ_surjective.forall]
    intro x hx
    simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, g] at hx
    rw [Submodule.liftQ_apply] at hx
    simp [mod, DFunLike.ext_iff, ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hx
    simp
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    choose c hc using hx
    refine ⟨bG.repr.symm ⟨(f x).support, c, by simp [hc, NeZero.ne]⟩, bG.repr.injective ?_⟩
    simpa [DFunLike.ext_iff, eq_comm] using hc
  · suffices mod ∘ bG.repr = g ∘ nG.mkQ by
      exact (this ▸ (mapRange_surjective _ (map_zero _) ZMod.intCast_surjective).comp
        bG.repr.surjective).of_comp
    ext x b
    simp [mod, comp_apply, mapRange.addMonoidHom_apply, Int.coe_castAddHom,
      mapRange_apply, QuotientAddGroup.coe_mk', g, f]
    rfl

declarations.source_snippet:
lemma weak_PFR_asymm_prelim (A B : Set G) [A_fin : Finite A] [B_fin : Finite B]
    (hnA : A.Nonempty) (hnB : B.Nonempty):
    ∃ (N : AddSubgroup G) (x y : G ⧸ N) (Ax By : Set G), Ax.Nonempty ∧ By.Nonempty ∧
    Set.Finite Ax ∧ Set.Finite By ∧ Ax = {z : G | z ∈ A ∧ QuotientAddGroup.mk' N z = x } ∧
    By = {z : G | z ∈ B ∧ QuotientAddGroup.mk' N z = y } ∧
    (log 2) * Module.finrank ℤ G ≤ log (Nat.card (G ⧸ N)) +
      40 * dᵤ[ A # B ] ∧ log (Nat.card A) + log (Nat.card B) - log (Nat.card Ax) - log (Nat.card By)
      ≤ 34 * (dᵤ[ A # B ] - dᵤ[ Ax # By ])
declarations.doc:
Given two non-empty finite subsets A, B of a rank n free Z-module G, there exists a subgroup N
and points x, y in G/N such that the fibers Ax, By of A, B over x, y respectively are non-empty,
one has the inequality $$\log\frac{|A| |B|}{|A_x| |B_y|} ≤ 34 (d[U_A; U_B] - d[U_{A_x}; U_{B_y}])$$
and one has the dimension bound $$n \log 2 ≤ \log |G/N| + 40 d[U_A; U_B]$$.

  [inst_5 : MeasurableSingletonClass.{u_1} G] (A B : Set.{u_1} G) [A_fin : Finite.{u_1 + 1} ↑A]
  [B_fin : Finite.{u_1 + 1} ↑B],
  Set.Nonempty.{u_1} A →
    Set.Nonempty.{u_1} B →
      ∃ N x y Ax By,
        And (Set.Nonempty.{u_1} Ax)
          (And (Set.Nonempty.{u_1} By)
            (And (Set.Finite.{u_1} Ax)
              (And (Set.Finite.{u_1} By)
                (And
                  (Eq.{u_1 + 1} Ax
                    (setOf.{u_1} fun z =>
                      And (Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} A z) (Eq.{u_1 + 1} ((QuotientAddGroup.mk'.{u_1} N) z) x)))
                  (And
                    (Eq.{u_1 + 1} By
                      (setOf.{u_1} fun z =>
                        And (Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} B z) (Eq.{u_1 + 1} ((QuotientAddGroup.mk'.{u_1} N) z) y)))
                    (And
                      (LE.le.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log 2) ↑(Module.finrank.{0, u_1} Int G))
                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u_1, u_1} G N)))
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 40 dᵤ[A # B])))
                      (LE.le.{0}
                        (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0}
                          (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0}
                            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑A)) (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑B)))
                            (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑Ax)))
                          (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑By)))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 34 (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} dᵤ[A # B] dᵤ[Ax # By])))))))))

declarations.name: Module.basisOfFiniteTypeTorsionFree
declarations.source_snippet:
noncomputable def Module.basisOfFiniteTypeTorsionFree [Fintype ι] {s : ι → M}
    (hs : span R (range s) = ⊤) [NoZeroSMulDivisors R M] : Σn : ℕ, Basis (Fin n) R M := by
  classical
                                                                                              
    have := exists_maximal_independent R s
    let I : Set ι := this.choose
    obtain
      ⟨indepI : LinearIndependent R (s ∘ (fun x => x) : I → M), hI :
        ∀ i ∉ I, ∃ a : R, a ≠ 0 ∧ a • s i ∈ span R (s '' I)⟩ :=
      this.choose_spec
    let N := span R (range <| (s ∘ (fun x => x) : I → M))
                                                    
    let _sI : I → N := fun i ↦ ⟨s i.1, subset_span (mem_range_self i)⟩
                                              
    let sI_basis : Basis I R N := Basis.span indepI
                                                               
    have exists_a : ∀ i : ι, ∃ a : R, a ≠ 0 ∧ a • s i ∈ N := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : i ∈ I
      · use 1, zero_ne_one.symm
        rw [one_smul]
        exact subset_span (mem_range_self (⟨i, hi⟩ : I))
      · simpa [image_eq_range s I] using hI i hi
    choose a ha ha' using exists_a
    let A := ∏ i, a i
    have hA : A ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
      simpa using ha
                                                          
    let φ : M →ₗ[R] M := LinearMap.lsmul R M A
    have : LinearMap.ker φ = ⊥ := @LinearMap.ker_lsmul R M _ _ _ _ _ hA
    let ψ := LinearEquiv.ofInjective φ (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp this)
    have : LinearMap.range φ ≤ N := by
                                  
      suffices ∀ i, φ (s i) ∈ N by
        rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map, ← hs, map_span_le]
        rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
        apply this
      intro i
      calc
        (∏ j ∈ {i}ᶜ, a j) • a i • s i ∈ N := N.smul_mem _ (ha' i)
        _ = (∏ j, a j) • s i := by rw [Fintype.prod_eq_prod_compl_mul i, mul_smul]

                                                                                  
    obtain ⟨n, b : Basis (Fin n) R (LinearMap.range φ)⟩ := Submodule.basisOfPidOfLE this sI_basis
                         
    exact ⟨n, b.map ψ.symm⟩
declarations.doc: A finite type torsion free module over a PID admits a basis.

declarations.source_snippet:
noncomputable def modNBasis : Basis (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ G) (ZMod n) (modN G n) := by
  set ψ : G →+ G := zsmulAddGroupHom n
  set nG := LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ G n)
  set H := G ⧸ nG
  set φ : G →ₗ[ℤ] H := nG.mkQ
  let B := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ G
  let bG : Basis B ℤ G := Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ G
  let mod : (B →₀ ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] (B →₀ ZMod n) := mapRange.linearMap (Int.castAddHom _).toIntLinearMap
  let f : G →ₗ[ℤ] (B →₀ ℤ) := bG.repr
  have hker : nG ≤ LinearMap.ker (mod.comp f) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    ext b
    simp [mod, f, nG, CharP.ofNat_eq_zero]
  let g : H →ₗ[ℤ] (B →₀ ZMod n) := nG.liftQ (mod.comp f) hker
  refine ⟨.ofBijective (g.toAddMonoidHom.toZModLinearMap n) ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [AddMonoidHom.coe_toZModLinearMap, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, injective_iff_map_eq_zero,
      nG.mkQ_surjective.forall]
    intro x hx
    simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, g] at hx
    rw [Submodule.liftQ_apply] at hx
    simp [mod, DFunLike.ext_iff, ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hx
    simp
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    choose c hc using hx
    refine ⟨bG.repr.symm ⟨(f x).support, c, by simp [hc, NeZero.ne]⟩, bG.repr.injective ?_⟩
    simpa [DFunLike.ext_iff, eq_comm] using hc
  · suffices mod ∘ bG.repr = g ∘ nG.mkQ by
      exact (this ▸ (mapRange_surjective _ (map_zero _) ZMod.intCast_surjective).comp
        bG.repr.surjective).of_comp
    ext x b
    simp [mod, comp_apply, mapRange.addMonoidHom_apply, Int.coe_castAddHom,
      mapRange_apply, QuotientAddGroup.coe_mk', g, f]
    rfl

declarations.source_snippet:
lemma weak_PFR_asymm_prelim (A B : Set G) [A_fin : Finite A] [B_fin : Finite B]
    (hnA : A.Nonempty) (hnB : B.Nonempty):
    ∃ (N : AddSubgroup G) (x y : G ⧸ N) (Ax By : Set G), Ax.Nonempty ∧ By.Nonempty ∧
    Set.Finite Ax ∧ Set.Finite By ∧ Ax = {z : G | z ∈ A ∧ QuotientAddGroup.mk' N z = x } ∧
    By = {z : G | z ∈ B ∧ QuotientAddGroup.mk' N z = y } ∧
    (log 2) * Module.finrank ℤ G ≤ log (Nat.card (G ⧸ N)) +
      40 * dᵤ[ A # B ] ∧ log (Nat.card A) + log (Nat.card B) - log (Nat.card Ax) - log (Nat.card By)
      ≤ 34 * (dᵤ[ A # B ] - dᵤ[ Ax # By ])

and points x, y in G/N such that the fibers Ax, By of A, B over x, y respectively are non-empty,
one has the inequality $$\log\frac{|A| |B|}{|A_x| |B_y|} ≤ 34 (d[U_A; U_B] - d[U_{A_x}; U_{B_y}])$$
and one has the dimension bound $$n \log 2 ≤ \log |G/N| + 40 d[U_A; U_B]$$.

  [B_fin : Finite.{u_1 + 1} ↑B],

        And (Set.Nonempty.{u_1} Ax)

            (And (Set.Finite.{u_1} Ax)

                (And

                      And (Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} A z) (Eq.{u_1 + 1} ((QuotientAddGroup.mk'.{u_1} N) z) x)))

                        (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0}
                          (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0}
                            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑A)) (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑B)))

lemma ent_bsg [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {A B : Ω → G} (hA : Measurable A) (hB : Measurable B)

declarations.name: Module.basisOfFiniteTypeTorsionFree
declarations.source_snippet:
noncomputable def Module.basisOfFiniteTypeTorsionFree [Fintype ι] {s : ι → M}
    (hs : span R (range s) = ⊤) [NoZeroSMulDivisors R M] : Σn : ℕ, Basis (Fin n) R M := by
  classical
                                                                                              
    have := exists_maximal_independent R s
    let I : Set ι := this.choose
    obtain
      ⟨indepI : LinearIndependent R (s ∘ (fun x => x) : I → M), hI :
        ∀ i ∉ I, ∃ a : R, a ≠ 0 ∧ a • s i ∈ span R (s '' I)⟩ :=
      this.choose_spec
    let N := span R (range <| (s ∘ (fun x => x) : I → M))
                                                    
    let _sI : I → N := fun i ↦ ⟨s i.1, subset_span (mem_range_self i)⟩
                                              
    let sI_basis : Basis I R N := Basis.span indepI
                                                               
    have exists_a : ∀ i : ι, ∃ a : R, a ≠ 0 ∧ a • s i ∈ N := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : i ∈ I
      · use 1, zero_ne_one.symm
        rw [one_smul]
        exact subset_span (mem_range_self (⟨i, hi⟩ : I))
      · simpa [image_eq_range s I] using hI i hi
    choose a ha ha' using exists_a
    let A := ∏ i, a i
    have hA : A ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
      simpa using ha
                                                          
    let φ : M →ₗ[R] M := LinearMap.lsmul R M A
    have : LinearMap.ker φ = ⊥ := @LinearMap.ker_lsmul R M _ _ _ _ _ hA
    let ψ := LinearEquiv.ofInjective φ (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp this)
    have : LinearMap.range φ ≤ N := by
                                  
      suffices ∀ i, φ (s i) ∈ N by
        rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map, ← hs, map_span_le]
        rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
        apply this
      intro i
      calc
        (∏ j ∈ {i}ᶜ, a j) • a i • s i ∈ N := N.smul_mem _ (ha' i)
        _ = (∏ j, a j) • s i := by rw [Fintype.prod_eq_prod_compl_mul i, mul_smul]

                                                                                  
    obtain ⟨n, b : Basis (Fin n) R (LinearMap.range φ)⟩ := Submodule.basisOfPidOfLE this sI_basis
                         
    exact ⟨n, b.map ψ.symm⟩
declarations.doc: A finite type torsion free module over a PID admits a basis.

result.statement: If $A,B\subseteq \mathbb {Z}^d$ are finite non-empty sets then there exist non-empty $A'\subseteq A$ and $B'\subseteq B$ such that \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] such that $\max (\dim A',\dim B')\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_A;U_B]$.
result.proof: Without loss of generality we can assume that $A$ and $B$ are not both inside (possibly distinct) cosets of the same subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$, or we just replace $\mathbb {Z}^d$ with that subgroup. We prove the result by induction on $\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. Let $\phi :\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ be the natural mod-2 homomorphism. By \Cref{torsion-dist-shrinking} \[ \max (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A)),\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))\leq 10d[U_A;U_B]. \] We now apply \Cref{pfr-projection}, obtaining some subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 40d[U_A;U_B] \] and \[ \mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_B))\leq 34 d[\tilde{\phi }(U_A);\tilde{\phi }(U_B)] \] where $\tilde{\phi }:\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ is $\phi $ composed with the projection onto $\mathbb {F}_2^d/H$. By \Cref{single-fibres} there exist $x,y\in \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ such that, with $A_x=A\cap \tilde{\phi }^{-1}(x)$ and similarly for $B_y$, \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq 34(d[U_A;U_B]-d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]). \] Suppose first that $\lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert =\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. This means that $\tilde{\phi }(A)=\{ x\} $ and $\tilde{\phi }(B)=\{ y\} $, and hence both $A$ and $B$ are in cosets of $\ker \tilde{\phi }$. Since by assumption $A,B$ are not in cosets of a proper subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$ this means $\ker \tilde{\phi }=\mathbb {Z}^d$, and so (examining the definition of $\tilde{\phi }$) we must have $H=\mathbb {F}_2^d$. Then our bound on $\log \lvert H\rvert $ forces $d\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and we are done with $A'=A$ and $B'=B$. Otherwise, \[ \lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert <\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert . \] By induction we can find some $A'\subseteq A_x$ and $B'\subseteq B_y$ such that $\dim A',\dim B'\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and \[ \log \frac{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]. \] Adding these inequalities implies \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] as required.

references.statement: If $G$ is a torsion-free group and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables and $\phi :G\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ is a homomorphism then \[ \mathbb {H}(\phi (X))\leq 10d[X;Y]. \]

references.label: pfr-projection
references.name: PFR_projection
references.statement: If $G=\mathbb {F}_2^d$ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$ and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables then there is a subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 2 (\mathbb {H}(X)+\mathbb {H}(Y)) \] and if $\psi :G \to G/H$ is the natural projection then \[ \mathbb {H}(\psi (X))+\mathbb {H}(\psi (Y))\leq 34 d[\psi (X);\psi (Y)]. \]

references.label: single-fibres
references.name: single_fibres
references.statement: Let $\phi :G\to H$ be a homomorphism and $A,B\subseteq G$ be finite subsets. If $x,y\in H$ then let $A_x=A\cap \phi ^{-1}(x)$ and $B_y=B\cap \phi ^{-1}(y)$. There exist $x,y\in H$ such that $A_x,B_y$ are both non-empty and \[ d[\phi (U_A);\phi (U_B)]\log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))(d(U_A,U_B)-d(U_{A_x},U_{B_y})). \]

and one has the dimension bound $$n \log 2 ≤ \log |G/N| + 40 d[U_A; U_B]$$.

def coimageIsoImageAux (i : F ⋙ G ≅ 𝟭 C) (adj : G ⊣ F) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    kernel (G.map (cokernel.π (F.map f))) ≅ kernel (cokernel.π f) := by
  have : PreservesColimits G := adj.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
  calc
    kernel (G.map (cokernel.π (F.map f))) ≅
        kernel (cokernel.π (G.map (F.map f)) ≫ cokernelComparison (F.map f) G) :=
      kernelIsoOfEq (π_comp_cokernelComparison _ _).symm
    _ ≅ kernel (cokernel.π (G.map (F.map f))) := kernelCompMono _ _
    _ ≅ kernel (cokernel.π (_ ≫ f ≫ _) ≫ (cokernelIsoOfEq _).hom) :=
      (kernelIsoOfEq (π_comp_cokernelIsoOfEq_hom (NatIso.naturality_2 i f)).symm)
    _ ≅ kernel (cokernel.π (_ ≫ f ≫ _)) := kernelCompMono _ _
    _ ≅ kernel (cokernel.π (f ≫ i.inv.app Y) ≫ (cokernelEpiComp (i.hom.app X) _).inv) :=
      (kernelIsoOfEq (by simp only [cokernel.π_desc, cokernelEpiComp_inv]))
    _ ≅ kernel (cokernel.π (f ≫ _)) := kernelCompMono _ _
    _ ≅ kernel (inv (i.inv.app Y) ≫ cokernel.π f ≫ (cokernelCompIsIso f (i.inv.app Y)).inv) :=
      (kernelIsoOfEq
        (by simp only [cokernel.π_desc, cokernelCompIsIso_inv, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc,
          NatIso.inv_inv_app]))
    _ ≅ kernel (cokernel.π f ≫ _) := kernelIsIsoComp _ _
    _ ≅ kernel (cokernel.π f) := kernelCompMono _ _

result.statement: If $A,B\subseteq \mathbb {Z}^d$ are finite non-empty sets then there exist non-empty $A'\subseteq A$ and $B'\subseteq B$ such that \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] such that $\max (\dim A',\dim B')\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_A;U_B]$.
result.proof: Without loss of generality we can assume that $A$ and $B$ are not both inside (possibly distinct) cosets of the same subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$, or we just replace $\mathbb {Z}^d$ with that subgroup. We prove the result by induction on $\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. Let $\phi :\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ be the natural mod-2 homomorphism. By \Cref{torsion-dist-shrinking} \[ \max (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A)),\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))\leq 10d[U_A;U_B]. \] We now apply \Cref{pfr-projection}, obtaining some subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 40d[U_A;U_B] \] and \[ \mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\tilde{\phi }(U_B))\leq 34 d[\tilde{\phi }(U_A);\tilde{\phi }(U_B)] \] where $\tilde{\phi }:\mathbb {Z}^d\to \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ is $\phi $ composed with the projection onto $\mathbb {F}_2^d/H$. By \Cref{single-fibres} there exist $x,y\in \mathbb {F}_2^d/H$ such that, with $A_x=A\cap \tilde{\phi }^{-1}(x)$ and similarly for $B_y$, \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq 34(d[U_A;U_B]-d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]). \] Suppose first that $\lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert =\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert $. This means that $\tilde{\phi }(A)=\{ x\} $ and $\tilde{\phi }(B)=\{ y\} $, and hence both $A$ and $B$ are in cosets of $\ker \tilde{\phi }$. Since by assumption $A,B$ are not in cosets of a proper subgroup of $\mathbb {Z}^d$ this means $\ker \tilde{\phi }=\mathbb {Z}^d$, and so (examining the definition of $\tilde{\phi }$) we must have $H=\mathbb {F}_2^d$. Then our bound on $\log \lvert H\rvert $ forces $d\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and we are done with $A'=A$ and $B'=B$. Otherwise, \[ \lvert A_x\rvert +\lvert B_y\rvert <\lvert A\rvert +\lvert B\rvert . \] By induction we can find some $A'\subseteq A_x$ and $B'\subseteq B_y$ such that $\dim A',\dim B'\leq \frac{40}{\log 2} d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]\leq \frac{40}{\log 2}d[U_A;U_B]$ and \[ \log \frac{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_{A_x};U_{B_y}]. \] Adding these inequalities implies \[ \log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A'\rvert \lvert B'\rvert }\leq 34d[U_A;U_B] \] as required.

references.statement: If $G$ is a torsion-free group and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables and $\phi :G\to \mathbb {F}_2^d$ is a homomorphism then \[ \mathbb {H}(\phi (X))\leq 10d[X;Y]. \]

references.label: pfr-projection
references.name: PFR_projection
references.statement: If $G=\mathbb {F}_2^d$ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$ and $X,Y$ are $G$-valued random variables then there is a subgroup $H\leq \mathbb {F}_2^d$ such that \[ \log \lvert H\rvert \leq 2 (\mathbb {H}(X)+\mathbb {H}(Y)) \] and if $\psi :G \to G/H$ is the natural projection then \[ \mathbb {H}(\psi (X))+\mathbb {H}(\psi (Y))\leq 34 d[\psi (X);\psi (Y)]. \]

references.label: single-fibres
references.name: single_fibres
references.statement: Let $\phi :G\to H$ be a homomorphism and $A,B\subseteq G$ be finite subsets. If $x,y\in H$ then let $A_x=A\cap \phi ^{-1}(x)$ and $B_y=B\cap \phi ^{-1}(y)$. There exist $x,y\in H$ such that $A_x,B_y$ are both non-empty and \[ d[\phi (U_A);\phi (U_B)]\log \frac{\lvert A\rvert \lvert B\rvert }{\lvert A_x\rvert \lvert B_y\rvert }\leq (\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_A))+\mathbb {H}(\phi (U_B)))(d(U_A,U_B)-d(U_{A_x},U_{B_y})). \]

declarations.name: WeakPFRAsymmConclusion
declarations.source_snippet:
def WeakPFRAsymmConclusion (A B : Set G) : Prop :=
  ∃ A' B' : Set G, A' ⊆ A ∧ B' ⊆ B ∧ A'.Nonempty ∧ B'.Nonempty ∧
  log ((Nat.card A * Nat.card B) / (Nat.card A' * (Nat.card B'))) ≤ 34 * dᵤ[A # B] ∧
  max (AffineSpace.finrank ℤ A') (AffineSpace.finrank ℤ B') ≤ (40 / log 2) * dᵤ[A # B]

/-- The property of two sets A,B of a group G not being contained in cosets of the same proper subgroup -/
declarations.doc: Separating out the conclusion of `weak_PFR_asymm` for convenience of induction arguments.
declarations.type: {G : Type u_1} → [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} G] → [inst : MeasurableSpace.{u_1} G] → Set.{u_1} G → Set.{u_1} G → Prop

definition.value:
fun {G} [AddCommGroup.{u_1} G] [MeasurableSpace.{u_1} G] A B =>
  ∃ A' B',
    And (HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} A' A)
      (And (HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} B' B)
        (And (Set.Nonempty.{u_1} A')
          (And (Set.Nonempty.{u_1} B')
            (And
              (LE.le.{0}
                (Real.log
                  (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑A) ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑B))
                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑A') ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑B'))))
                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 34 dᵤ[A # B]))
              (LE.le.{0}
                (↑(Max.max.{0} (AffineSpace.finrank.{0, u_1, u_1} Int A') (AffineSpace.finrank.{0, u_1, u_1} Int B')))
                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} 40 (Real.log 2)) dᵤ[A # B]))))))

declarations.name: AffineSubspace.equivMapOfInjective
declarations.source_snippet:
@[simps linear, simps! toFun]
noncomputable def equivMapOfInjective (E : AffineSubspace 𝕜 P₁) [Nonempty E] (φ : P₁ →ᵃ[𝕜] P₂)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) : E ≃ᵃ[𝕜] E.map φ :=
  { Equiv.Set.image _ (E : Set P₁) hφ with
    linear :=
      (E.direction.equivMapOfInjective φ.linear (φ.linear_injective_iff.mpr hφ)).trans
        (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (AffineSubspace.map_direction _ _).symm)
    map_vadd' := fun p v => Subtype.ext <| φ.map_vadd p v }
declarations.doc:
An affine subspace is isomorphic to its image under an injective affine map.
This is the affine version of `Submodule.equivMapOfInjective`.

declarations.name: WeakPFRAsymmConclusion
declarations.source_snippet:
def WeakPFRAsymmConclusion (A B : Set G) : Prop :=
  ∃ A' B' : Set G, A' ⊆ A ∧ B' ⊆ B ∧ A'.Nonempty ∧ B'.Nonempty ∧
  log ((Nat.card A * Nat.card B) / (Nat.card A' * (Nat.card B'))) ≤ 34 * dᵤ[A # B] ∧
  max (AffineSpace.finrank ℤ A') (AffineSpace.finrank ℤ B') ≤ (40 / log 2) * dᵤ[A # B]

/-- The property of two sets A,B of a group G not being contained in cosets of the same proper subgroup -/
declarations.doc: Separating out the conclusion of `weak_PFR_asymm` for convenience of induction arguments.
declarations.type: {G : Type u_1} → [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} G] → [inst : MeasurableSpace.{u_1} G] → Set.{u_1} G → Set.{u_1} G → Prop

definition.value:
fun {G} [AddCommGroup.{u_1} G] [MeasurableSpace.{u_1} G] A B =>
  ∃ A' B',
    And (HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} A' A)
      (And (HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} B' B)
        (And (Set.Nonempty.{u_1} A')
          (And (Set.Nonempty.{u_1} B')
            (And
              (LE.le.{0}
                (Real.log
                  (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑A) ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑B))
                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑A') ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑B'))))
                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 34 dᵤ[A # B]))
              (LE.le.{0}
                (↑(Max.max.{0} (AffineSpace.finrank.{0, u_1, u_1} Int A') (AffineSpace.finrank.{0, u_1, u_1} Int B')))
                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} 40 (Real.log 2)) dᵤ[A # B]))))))

declarations.name: weak_PFR_asymm_prelim
declarations.source_snippet:
lemma weak_PFR_asymm_prelim (A B : Set G) [A_fin : Finite A] [B_fin : Finite B]
    (hnA : A.Nonempty) (hnB : B.Nonempty):
    ∃ (N : AddSubgroup G) (x y : G ⧸ N) (Ax By : Set G), Ax.Nonempty ∧ By.Nonempty ∧
    Set.Finite Ax ∧ Set.Finite By ∧ Ax = {z : G | z ∈ A ∧ QuotientAddGroup.mk' N z = x } ∧
    By = {z : G | z ∈ B ∧ QuotientAddGroup.mk' N z = y } ∧
    (log 2) * Module.finrank ℤ G ≤ log (Nat.card (G ⧸ N)) +
      40 * dᵤ[ A # B ] ∧ log (Nat.card A) + log (Nat.card B) - log (Nat.card Ax) - log (Nat.card By)
      ≤ 34 * (dᵤ[ A # B ] - dᵤ[ Ax # By ])
declarations.doc:
Given two non-empty finite subsets A, B of a rank n free Z-module G, there exists a subgroup N
and points x, y in G/N such that the fibers Ax, By of A, B over x, y respectively are non-empty,
one has the inequality $$\log\frac{|A| |B|}{|A_x| |B_y|} ≤ 34 (d[U_A; U_B] - d[U_{A_x}; U_{B_y}])$$
and one has the dimension bound $$n \log 2 ≤ \log |G/N| + 40 d[U_A; U_B]$$.
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} G] [inst_1 : Module.Free.{0, u_1} Int G]
  [inst_2 : Module.Finite.{0, u_1} Int G] [inst_3 : Countable.{u_1 + 1} G] [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace.{u_1} G]
  [inst_5 : MeasurableSingletonClass.{u_1} G] (A B : Set.{u_1} G) [A_fin : Finite.{u_1 + 1} ↑A]
  [B_fin : Finite.{u_1 + 1} ↑B],
  Set.Nonempty.{u_1} A →
    Set.Nonempty.{u_1} B →
      ∃ N x y Ax By,
        And (Set.Nonempty.{u_1} Ax)
          (And (Set.Nonempty.{u_1} By)
            (And (Set.Finite.{u_1} Ax)
              (And (Set.Finite.{u_1} By)
                (And
                  (Eq.{u_1 + 1} Ax
                    (setOf.{u_1} fun z =>
                      And (Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} A z) (Eq.{u_1 + 1} ((QuotientAddGroup.mk'.{u_1} N) z) x)))
                  (And
                    (Eq.{u_1 + 1} By
                      (setOf.{u_1} fun z =>
                        And (Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} B z) (Eq.{u_1 + 1} ((QuotientAddGroup.mk'.{u_1} N) z) y)))
                    (And
                      (LE.le.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log 2) ↑(Module.finrank.{0, u_1} Int G))
                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u_1, u_1} G N)))
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 40 dᵤ[A # B])))
                      (LE.le.{0}
                        (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0}
                          (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0}
                            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑A)) (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑B)))
                            (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑Ax)))
                          (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑By)))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 34 (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} dᵤ[A # B] dᵤ[Ax # By])))))))))
declarations.conclusion:
∃ N x y Ax By,
  And (Set.Nonempty.{u_1} Ax)
    (And (Set.Nonempty.{u_1} By)
      (And (Set.Finite.{u_1} Ax)
        (And (Set.Finite.{u_1} By)
          (And
            (Eq.{u_1 + 1} Ax
              (setOf.{u_1} fun z =>
                And (Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} A z) (Eq.{u_1 + 1} ((QuotientAddGroup.mk'.{u_1} N) z) x)))
            (And
              (Eq.{u_1 + 1} By
                (setOf.{u_1} fun z =>
                  And (Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} B z) (Eq.{u_1 + 1} ((QuotientAddGroup.mk'.{u_1} N) z) y)))
              (And
                (LE.le.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log 2) ↑(Module.finrank.{0, u_1} Int G))
                  (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u_1, u_1} G N)))
                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 40 dᵤ[A # B])))
                (LE.le.{0}
                  (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0}
                    (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0}
                      (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑A)) (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑B)))
                      (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑Ax)))
                    (Real.log ↑(Nat.card.{u_1} ↑By)))
                  (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 34 (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} dᵤ[A # B] dᵤ[Ax # By])))))))))

declarations.name: MonoidHom.transfer
declarations.source_snippet:
@[to_additive "Given `ϕ : H →+ A` from `H : AddSubgroup G` to an additive commutative group `A`,
the transfer homomorphism is `transfer ϕ : G →+ A`."]
noncomputable def transfer [FiniteIndex H] : G →* A :=
  let T : leftTransversals (H : Set G) := Inhabited.default
  { toFun := fun g => diff ϕ T (g • T)
                                                                                                                     
    map_one' := by beta_reduce; rw [one_smul, diff_self]
                                                                
    map_mul' := fun g h => by simp only; rw [mul_smul, ← diff_mul_diff, smul_diff_smul] }

variable (T : leftTransversals (H : Set G))
declarations.doc:
Given `ϕ : H →* A` from `H : Subgroup G` to a commutative group `A`,
the transfer homomorphism is `transfer ϕ : G →* A`.
